english.note: This is the everyday all-purpose word for feces, though it is blunt.

exampleSentences.jyutping: go3 sai3 lou6 o1 zo2 si2 laa3

english.note: Use this for excrement, especially when talking about animal mess or faeces.

exampleSentences.english: The dog's mess is all over the floor.
